instruction: Test your network speed via speedtest.net and record the Ping, Download, and Upload metrics in ~/Benchmarks/network_stats.txt. Create the Benchmarks directory if missing, and list each result on its own line with a tab between the label and number.

metadata.explanation: This variation uses the term 'benchmark' instead of 'test', changes the output directory to ~/Benchmarks/network_stats.txt, and specifies tab character as the separator instead of single space. The task maintains the same complexity as the original - measuring three core metrics (Ping, Download, Upload) from speedtest.net and saving to a text file. Uses a custom metric to verify proper formatting: each measurement on a separate line with name and value separated by tab character.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if all three metrics (Ping, Download, Upload) are present in the file with proper tab-separated format (Label\tValue) on separate lines and numeric values, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts file content from the specified path using env.controller.get_file() with proper UTF-8 decoding
Metric properly validates tab-separated format using regex pattern '^(Ping|Download|Upload)\t(.+)$'
Evaluator validates each measurement is on a separate line by splitting on newlines and checking each line individually
All three required metrics (Ping, Download, Upload) are verified to be present using found_metrics set comparison
Numeric validation correctly ensures values contain at least one digit using re.search(r'\d', value)
Complete instruction coverage: checks tab separation, separate lines, all three metrics, and numeric values
Edge cases handled: missing file returns empty string -> 0.0 score, empty file -> 0.0 score
